title: Diamond with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,8 78,35 50,92 22,35' fill='#66d9ff' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Top facet -->
  <polygon points='50,8 78,35 50,42 22,35' fill='#b8f0ff' stroke='#e0f8ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Left facet -->
  <polygon points='22,35 50,42 50,92' fill='#44c4ee' stroke='#8ae2ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Right facet -->
  <polygon points='78,35 50,42 50,92' fill='#22a8dd' stroke='#6ad4ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d='M30 18 L32 22 L36 24 L32 26 L30 30 L28 26 L24 24 L28 22 Z' fill='#fff7a0'/>
  <path d='M72 14 L73.5 17 L76.5 18.5 L73.5 20 L72 23 L70.5 20 L67.5 18.5 L70.5 17 Z' fill='#fff7a0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='55' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a2a50'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='55' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a2a50'/>
  <!-- Eye shines -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M39 68 Q50 80 61 68' fill='none' stroke='#1a2a50' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
